metadata.name: PostSingleTransaction
metadata.description: This API is used to post Single transaction for an account.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: StoreID
request_fields.description: Unique Number which is assgined to a Store. Valid Values:0-9 Example:1234

request_fields.name: RegisterID
request_fields.description: Unique ID assigned to a Register. Valid Values:a-z 0-9 Example:123456 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Card Holder's Account Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896325874 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency code corresponding to the Transaction Amount. Valid Values:840 for US Dollar Example:840 Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: TransactionDescription
request_fields.description: User defined description of transaction if entered by user explicitly. If not entered by the user, then system will generate it. Valid Values:A-Z,0-9 Example:Purchase/Payment. Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: TransactionCode
request_fields.description: A code to identify type of payment. Valid Values: The valid values of Transaction Code can be fetched from GetTranCodeByUserID API. Example:427248 = Principal Adjustment Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ProductCode
request_fields.description: Specific code assigned to the product. Valid Values: Refer Section 5.47 of Appendix Example: 12456 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SettlementDate
request_fields.description: Date of Settlement. Valid Values:0-9 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

request_fields.name: CreditPlanMaster
request_fields.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:6051 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PaymentReferenceID
request_fields.description: Refernce ID of the Payment. Valid Values:0-9, A-z Format:XXXXXXXXXXX Example:fy76869878gh Allowable Values: 36

request_fields.name: TransmissionDateTime
request_fields.description: Time of transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM-DD-YYYTHH:mm:ss Example:12-30-2015T13:05:10

request_fields.name: EffectiveDateTime
request_fields.description: Effective Date of Transaction Valid Values:01/15/2020 Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantType
request_fields.description: Type of Merchant Valid Values:a-z Example: Retail,Hospital Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid). Valid Values:0-9 Example:7485122 Condition:At least one of AdminNumber/AccountNumber is required.

request_fields.name: ReversalTargetTranID
request_fields.description: Transaction number of target transaction which is going to be reversed. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:12345 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ReturnTransactionID
request_fields.description: Transaction ID generated for The Return Transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Example:122390308

request_fields.name: MethodName
request_fields.description: Method Name uniquely identifies bank accounts in Core card system. Whenever user adds any bank account.This is required If User wants to send transaction in ACH. Valid Values:0-9 Example:4092 Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Number which is assigned to a Merchant. Valid Values: 0-9 Example:11642 Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: Incoice Number for Transaction. Valid Values: A-Z 0-9 Example: AB987567757 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: FeeReversalReason
request_fields.description: Reason for Fee Reversal. Valid Values: 0 - Customers Goodwill , 1- Erroneous charges Example: 0 - Customers Goodwill Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CheckNumber
request_fields.description: Number of the Payment Check. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXX Example:89874545 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: IdentifierToken
request_fields.description: A generated token that is not expired can be used as an input field to access API. If we are passing this field in input, user should not pass any other account identifier. Condition:At least one account identifier is required. Allowable Values: 800

request_fields.name: AllowForcePost
request_fields.description: To Force Post a Transaction. Valid Values: 0,1 Format: X Example: 0 = No, 1 = Yes

request_fields.name: UniqueId
request_fields.description: Unique ID is a transaction specific unique ID. This ID is unique for every transaction. If multiple calls are made by client for a specific transaction, the value of this tag will always be the same for a specific transaction. (GUID and UUID datatypes are supported for this tag). Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example: F965C56F-C58F-EC11-B80E-A4BF010A357E Condition:For API user, if API Idempotency Applicable is set as Yes on CoreCredit, field is mandatory. The UniqueId is valid for 7 days from first submission of the request. Same request can be retried for 7 days without performing the same action twice.Idempotency will be checked at the belongingOwning Partner and Merchant Level. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: InterestPlanID
request_fields.description: Interest Plan Id defined on Interest Tables. Valid Values :0-9, A-z Example: 1233 Condition: Interest Plan Override setup should be enabled at Plan

request_fields.name: PortfolioID
request_fields.description: Description: Indicates details of lender institution mapped on account. Valid Values: Under special characters only Hypen (-) and Underscore () are allowed. No spaces allowed in between strings. Example: Under special characters only Hypen (-) and Underscore () are allowed. No spaces allowed in between strings.

request_fields.name: OverpaymentPlansGroup
request_fields.description: The credit Plan Master group ID can be in this field to apply an overpayment to the plans that belongs to that group first. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1233

request_fields.name: InitialInterest
request_fields.description: Initial Interest which needs to be posted at the time of Loan creation. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 5000.00 Condition: This tag is applicable for a Plan Master with a Plan Type of Retail and a Payment Typeclassified as either [Equal Payments with Interest] or [Use Equal Payments].

request_fields.name: InitialFee
request_fields.description: Initial Fee which needs to be posted at the time of Loan creation. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 5000.00 Condition: This tag is applicable for a Plan Master with a Plan Type of Retail and a Payment Typeclassified as either [Equal Payments with Interest] or [Use Equal Payments].

request_fields.name: InitialCurrentAmountDue
request_fields.description: Initial Current Amount Due which needs to be posted at the time of Loan creation. Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXXXXX Example: 5000.00 Condition: This tag is applicable for a Plan Master with a Plan Type of Retail and a Payment Typeclassified as either [Equal Payments with Interest] or [Use Equal Payments].

request_fields.name: LoanTerm
request_fields.description: Loan terms in months. Valid Values : 1-360 Example: 10

request_fields.name: TNPFlag
request_fields.description: TNPFlag Valid Values: 0, 1 Example: 0

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10
